steps.shell:
- name: "5.18 | PATCH | Ensure 'Problem Reports and Solutions Control Panel Support (wercplsupport)' is set to 'Disabled'"
  when: win11cis_rule_5_18
  tags:
    - level2-high-security-sensitive-data-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_5.18
    - wercplsupport
  block:
    - name: "5.18 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Problem Reports and Solutions Control Panel Support (wercplsupport)' is set to 'Disabled' | Check to see if wercplsupport service exists"
      ansible.windows.win_service_info:
        name: wercplsupport
      register: discovered_5_18_wercplsupport_service_info

    - name: "5.18 | PATCH | Ensure 'Problem Reports and Solutions Control Panel Support (wercplsupport)' is set to 'Disabled' | Disable wercplsupport service"
      when: discovered_5_18_wercplsupport_service_info.exists
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: wercplsupport
        start_mode: disabled
        state: stopped
